level.name: Amber Hollow
level.subtitle: A first flight through the sandstone.

level.name: The Narrows
level.subtitle: Hold your line beneath the hanging rock.

level.name: Cinder Passage
level.subtitle: One careful crossing. One small landing pad.

level.name: Knife-edge Sprint
level.subtitle: Turn nose-first through the final ring. No landing.
level.brief: Microgravity sprint. Climb before pitching over. Cross the ring from left to right, nose horizontal (within 25°), with the whole hull inside it. No landing required.

level.name: Silver Sea
level.subtitle: Long coasts over a quiet moon.
level.brief: Gravity is 0.40× Aurelia. Thrust gently, then coast. Beat both rivals to a controlled landing.

level.name: Ironfall
level.subtitle: A heavy world. Every burn matters.
level.brief: Gravity is 1.75× Aurelia. You need longer burns to stay up. Engine and lightweight-frame upgrades improve thrust to weight.

level.name: Pelagic Run
level.subtitle: Buoyancy, water resistance, and a bubble trail.
level.brief: Fully submerged. Buoyancy offsets gravity, but water drag resists every manoeuvre. Your exhaust becomes a bubble trail. Land on the seabed platform.

level.name: Milkglass Banks
level.subtitle: Dense cloud banks steal your speed.
level.brief: Fly through all three gates in order. White cloud volumes add real drag: carry momentum in, and burn to get out. These gates accept any ship orientation.

level.name: Against the Gale
level.subtitle: A relentless 9 m/s wind from the finish.
level.brief: A 9 m/s headwind blows left. Tilt into it to make progress and compensate during landing. Dust streaks show the wind direction.

level.name: The Unlit
level.subtitle: Fog, engine glow, and distant navigation beacons.
level.brief: No ambient light. Navigate by your lamps, the rivals’ lights, and engine flames. Short burns reveal the nearby rock through the fog. The green navigation beacons mark your landing pad.

level.name: Above the Air
level.subtitle: Climb out of the thick air. Then build sideways speed.
level.brief: Climb to 55–100 m above the surface. Dense low air reduces engine output and adds drag. In thin air, turn sideways and reach circular orbital speed. Hold altitude, vertical speed under 1.8 m/s, and 95–115% target orbital speed for 3 seconds. Game distances and speeds are scaled.

level.name: Driftfield
level.subtitle: A tiny pod, gentle jets and a slow-moving meteor storm.
level.brief: Pilot the supplied 68 cm pod through a slowly moving meteor storm. WASD or arrows fire tiny jets in all four directions; Space also moves up. Release to coast and use opposite thrust to brake. Aim below 0.8 m/s: gentle bumps are safe, harder impacts damage the pod. Approach the green docking beacon at under 0.35 m/s and hold for 1.5 seconds. Everyone uses the same low-power pod, regardless of upgrades.
